reviews.title: Install this app
reviews.text: I genuinely think anyone who’s trying to get their life together and actually build real habits should give this app a shot. I’m not even being dramatic this thing is low key changing my life, like everything has improved since I started using it, I’ve started reading books again, I’ve been going to the gym consistently which never happens for me, it’s so helpful having all your tasks right there in front of you and it genuinely feels like a game, like i actively wanna complete everything in the list each day and I would seriously recommend it, if you’re anything like me and you struggle with staying consistent or just getting your life together, try this, it’s actually worth it

reviews.title: For an app that costs money I expected more…
reviews.text: I’m disappointed with this app. There’s nothing special or cool about it, it’s actually quite boring. I’m looking for a more interesting and interactive app.

reviews.title: Unethical tricks
reviews.text: They don’t have a trial and ask you pay for a year without even knowing what you’re paying for; they also use a cheap trick of showing you a bigger price at first and then - when you close the window - they try to rush you into getting it for 50% off in a 5 min window. This is a textbook psychological manipulation that is inconsistent with their stated mission (just like using a ton of colors and animations when talking about dopamine to… make us release more dopamine and want to buy it).

reviews.title: Another “free” app
reviews.text: After an ad that look a a free planner app with a cool interface, I was quickly disappointed by the same dsm5 questionnaire and a paid monthly subscription. The best part it asks you rate before you pay, so here. Normally I would just move on with my life, but since I don’t know what else I can do with my free time: you don’t need this app you already have all of the tools. You just need the experience to use them so start using your calendar app start using your reminder app don’t give your money to whatever this thing is.
